name: kerplunk
description: Compile Markdown and Word documents into Canvas-safe, accessible HTML with inlined theme styles and Canvas QTI quizzes.

scripts.test: node test/link-resolver.test.js && node test/code-accessibility.test.js && node test/html-simplify.test.js && node test/heading-anchors.test.js
scripts.install-cli: node scripts/bundle.js && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp dist/kerplunk ~/.local/bin/kerplunk && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/kerplunk && echo '✅ kerplunk installed to ~/.local/bin/kerplunk'

author: Eric Artzt
